messages:
Sophie (AE): FYI — POC with TriMetrics wraps next Wed. They said they'll sign a 12mo committed deal (~$200k ARR) if we cut 25%-30% off list. Need deal-desk/finance OK for bespoke pricing + dedicated instance asks.

Kevin (Sales Ops): can you drop the current rate card vs ask? also list any concessions (SLA, infra, custom work). linking sheet helps.

Sophie (AE): copy of ask below:
```
Standard list: $0.12/token gen / $0.02/token embed (example)
12mo commit: $200,000
Requested discount: 30%
Net ARR: $140,000
Concessions: dedicated VPC + 99.9% SLA, SCIM/SSO, data retention 7yrs, no custom model training
```

Emma (Deal Desk): quick Qs — margin floor here? is this replacing an incumbent or stealing share? any legal / security blockers? If >25% we need a short memo and VP signoff.

Raj (SE): POC metrics: latency P95 120ms, token cost profile matches mid-size apps. Security questionnaire 80% complete; customer requires SOC2 report, SSO (SAML + SCIM), and a VPC peering option. No request for custom model training, they want dedicated infra only.

Jess (Finance): rough math — at 30% discount gross margin drops ~X% (I ran a quick calc). We need to confirm expected GPU ops backlog and whether Dedicated capacity is already reserved. Also want clarity on commit cadence (monthly vs upfront).

Sophie (AE): customer prefers monthly invoicing but will lock 12mo commit. They asked if we can move to 24mo for 35% — potentially. They explicitly want auto-renew off unless price increase <10% next year.

Emma (Deal Desk): propose flows: approve up to 25% via deal desk; >25% escalate to VP Sales + Finance signoff + Legal T&Cs. If we're asked 30% for 12mo we need: 1) exec signoff, 2) documented margin impact, 3) security checklist done, 4) no engineering dev commitments.

Kevin (Sales Ops): putting details in the deals sheet: https://redwood.example.com/sales-deals/trimetrics (placeholder). Sophie pls attach SQ summary and CISO contact.

Sophie (AE): attached SQ summary in thread (uploaded). CISO contact: amy@trimetrics.com. No custom dev. They want dedicated instance + IP allowlist.

Jess (Finance): conditional approval path: if 12mo $200k commit and Dedicated infra already capacity-planned, Finance can greenlight up to 28% discount with auto-bill monthly and 30-day cancellation penalty. Anything >28% needs CFO approval. We'll need ARR recognition plan and refund terms.

Emma (Deal Desk): LegalBot — flag for T&Cs: VPC + dedicated hosting + IP allowlist => must include indemnity and SLA carveout. LegalBot: pinged legal queue (ETA 48h).

Sophie (AE): final ask for thread: Approve 30% off on 12mo $200k commit conditioned on: 99.9% SLA, no engineering custom work, monthly billing, auto-renew opt-out w/ <=10% increase year2, DPA + SOC2 evidence. If not possible, can confirm 25% immediate.

Kevin (Sales Ops): noted. @Emma @Jess please confirm yes/no or what to escalate. reaction :eyes:

Emma (Deal Desk): I can approve up to 25% now. For 30% we need VP Sales + CFO signoff and Legal signoff on the SLA language. Please prepare a 1-paragraph commercial memo summarizing win rationale, competitive risk, and customer references.

Jess (Finance): agree with Emma. I'll prep the margin calc and a short finance memo. Tentatively will support escalation to CFO if Legal + SE confirm no additional ops burden.

Raj (SE): security checklist will be finished by EOD tomorrow. No additional engineering work requested beyond infra setup.

Sophie (AE): thanks. I'll draft the commercial memo and ping VP Sales for signoff if legal and finance are green. will update sheet and drop the memo link here. :thumbsup:

LegalBot: legal intake submitted (ID 2026-042). Assigned to @LegalTeam. ETA 2 business days.

Kevin (Sales Ops): closing loop — next steps: 1) Sophie drop memo + sheet, 2) Raj finish SQ, 3) Jess run final margin calc, 4) Emma / VP decide on escalation. staying on this thread for approvals.
